blocks.text: Woh compounds jin ka chemical formula aur bonds ek jaise hon lekin ligands ka space mein arrangement (tarteeb) alag ho, stereoisomers kehlate hain. Stereoisomerism ki do types (qismein) hain: geometrical isomerism aur optical isomerism.

blocks.prompt: Complexes mein stereoisomerism ki do types batayein.

items: Stereoisomers: formula aur bonds wahi, ligands ka space mein arrangement alag; do types: geometrical aur optical.
